description: This file defines the GenericDispatcherFactory class which implements a factory for creating LocalDispatcher instances, including an inner class for the GenericDispatcher that handles synchronous and asynchronous service invocations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDispatcherFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates and manages instances of LocalDispatcher, specifically customized 'GenericDispatcher' objects that manage service execution within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDispatcher
classes.description: An inner static class extending GenericAbstractDispatcher, implementing the actual dispatch logic for running services synchronously or asynchronously, with support for transaction management and enabling/disabling certain features like Ecas.

methods.name: createLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a LocalDispatcher instance for a given name and delegator, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: disableEcas
methods.description: Method to disable Ecas (whatever feature that implies within this context).

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with the given context, optionally with transaction timeout and transaction requirements.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously but ignores errors, with optional transaction control.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes a service asynchronously with specified parameters, including persistence and transaction control.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and returns a waiter object to wait for completion.
